title: Band-9 Samples: How often do you buy new clothes for yourself? [Why?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 12 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 2 Test 3 question: “How often do you buy new clothes for yourself? [Why?]” Sample 1: Frequently Female Male I must admit, I’ve been acquiring new clothes more regularly since I started shopping online. Every couple of weeks, I’d say. Technology has made it so easy to browse through a vast selection of garments without leaving the comfort of my home. In addition, with personalized ads showing me the latest styles that match my preferences, it becomes almost impossible to resist adding items to my cart. Sample 2: Frequently Female Male I add new pieces to my wardrobe quite frequently. The primary reason is my deep appreciation for fashion. I’m always intrigued by the evolving trends and innovative designs presented each season. This keeps me excited about investing in fresh outfits regularly. Plus, wearing new clothes often gives me a sense of confidence and allows me to express my personality. Sample 3: Frequently Female Male I often find myself purchasing new attire, primarily due to my work as a social media influencer. Being in this line of work requires me to constantly update my wardrobe to keep my content fresh and engaging. My followers look forward to seeing the latest trends and styles, and I enjoy the creative process of styling and showcasing these outfits. It’s a win-win situation, really! Sample 4: Moderately Female Male My acquisitions of new clothing items are moderately spaced, usually in line with the fashion seasons. As a fashion enthusiast, I love experimenting with new trends, but I also understand the importance of being a responsible consumer. So, I balance my passion with my responsibility by purchasing new items only when they truly resonate with my style. Sample 5: Moderately Female Male My purchases of fresh clothes are quite measured, mostly dictated by practical needs. I believe in the functionality of clothes over their aesthetic appeal. So, I only add to my wardrobe when I notice a gap, like needing warmer clothes for winter, or when my existing clothes are worn out. This pragmatic approach prevents unnecessary accumulation and promotes mindful consumption. Sample 6: Moderately Female Male Well, I’m an avid runner, so I tend to get new running clothes every two or three months. The continuous wear and tear, combined with the washing, shortens their lifespan. However, I see it as an investment towards my health and fitness. Sample 7: Rarely Female Male Frankly, I seldom shop for new clothes because I value my time more than shopping. The process of browsing, trying on, and purchasing clothes can be time-consuming. Instead, I prefer investing that time in personal growth, learning new skills, or building relationships. Sample 8: Rarely Female Male I don’t frequently purchase new attire, perhaps only a couple of times a year. My primary reason is sustainability. I believe in the philosophy of ‘less is more’, and I try to minimize my contribution to fast fashion, which is notoriously detrimental to the environment. Instead, I opt for quality over quantity, buying durable items that can withstand the test of time. Sample 9: Rarely Female Male As someone who lives a nomadic lifestyle, I infrequently add to my clothing collection. Traveling light is an essential aspect of my life, and having a compact, versatile wardrobe helps me stay mobile and unencumbered. Sample 10: It Depends Female Male In my case, the frequency of purchasing new garments is not set in stone. More often than not, it’s tied to specific events or occasions. For example, if there’s a wedding to attend or a business meeting on the horizon, I might scout for an appropriate outfit. So, it’s fair to say, my clothes shopping is more occasion-oriented rather than on a regular schedule.
